newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Pakistan National Refining turnaround on Apr 25.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan National Refining turnaround on Apr 25.

text.p: SINGAPORE, April 7 (Singapore) - Pakistan's state-owned National Refining Ltd has scheduled to close its 63,000-barrel-per-day (bpd) refinery for 20-days from April 25, a source with the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Resources said on Monday.
The maintenance shutdown, originally planned for February, was delayed to allow the refinery "to make arrangements with the contractors" for the routine maintenance, a source said in February.
He said the April shutdown at the Karachi refinery was the only one of Pakistan's three refineries scheduled for this year.
Due to the shutdown, the Minstry brought forward its June gasoline requirement to May, and doubled its imports in May to 50,000 tonnes, the source said.
But there was no additional demand for other oil products as the Ministry has already covered through term contract supplies.
